name: revit-model-mcp
description: For people reviewing or automating Revit models with an AI client: read a live Revit model through MCP, read-only by default, and act in it only when two explicit gates are on. Requires uv on the client PATH: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/.
long_description: Actions are opt-in and require both the client setting and the workstation allow-write file. The Revit add-in must be installed separately on Windows. macOS and Linux clients connect to a remote Windows workstation.

tools.name: revit_ping
tools.description: Check the RevitModelMcp connection without reading the model.

tools.name: revit_document_info
tools.description: Read general information about the active Revit model.

tools.name: revit_model_health
tools.description: Read model quality counts before an export or hand-over.

tools.name: revit_links_status
tools.description: Read RVT, CAD and image link status before an export or hand-over.

tools.name: revit_shared_coordinates
tools.description: Read project and survey coordinates before an export or hand-over.

tools.name: revit_parameter_fill_check
tools.description: Count filled, empty and missing parameters before an export or hand-over.

tools.name: revit_list_catalog
tools.description: Discover valid model names before filtering.

tools.name: revit_aggregate_elements
tools.description: Summarize matching elements by one or two fields after revit_list_catalog.

tools.name: revit_query_elements
tools.description: Read a page of matching element rows after revit_list_catalog.

tools.name: revit_list_views
tools.description: Find non-template views before analyzing a view.

tools.name: revit_view_summary
tools.description: Read element categories and counts for a selected view.

tools.name: revit_export_view
tools.description: Export a selected view to PNG when numbers do not explain geometry.

tools.name: revit_export_element_ids
tools.description: Write the identifier register of the drawn components to an xlsx file on the Revit workstation.

tools.name: revit_view_elements
tools.description: Read one page of elements in a selected view.

tools.name: revit_element_details
tools.description: Read parameters and geometry of an element by Revit ID.

tools.name: revit_view_warnings
tools.description: Read warnings involving elements present in a selected view.

tools.name: revit_list_warnings
tools.description: Group model warnings by description text.

tools.name: revit_list_relations
tools.description: Read model object membership or dependencies.

tools.name: revit_list_instances
tools.description: List Revit processes and their active documents.

tools.name: revit_select
tools.description: Select element IDs for inspection in Revit; an empty list clears selection; IDs are unitless.

tools.name: revit_show
tools.description: Show elements, optionally selecting them; open a level plan or 3D view when needed. Returns activeView, viewOpened and dialogsSuppressed; IDs are unitless.

tools.name: revit_isolate
tools.description: Temporarily isolate IDs for visual review in the active view, or reset with an empty list; IDs are unitless.

tools.name: revit_move
tools.description: Move elements when adjusting their position; dx_mm, dy_mm and dz_mm are offsets in millimetres on model axes.

tools.name: revit_place_family
tools.description: Place a loaded unhosted family on a named level for layout.

tools.name: revit_create_wall
tools.description: Create a straight wall for layout on a named level; model XY endpoints and height are millimetres; null wall_type chooses the first basic type.

tools.name: revit_create_floor
tools.description: Create a floor from a closed boundary for layout on a named level.

tools.name: revit_create_level
tools.description: Create a level at a given elevation for layout.

tools.name: revit_set_phase
tools.description: Assign the created or demolished project phase of elements by exact phase name.

tools.name: revit_merge_phases
tools.description: Merge one project phase into another by moving every element reference.

tools.name: revit_set_parameter
tools.description: Set a named instance parameter, falling back to its shared type; use for edits, with length in mm, area in m2 and other doubles in internal units.

tools.name: revit_set_view_lighting
tools.description: Set the lighting of one view: shadows, sun position, ground plane, background and the rendering lighting scheme.

tools.name: revit_delete
tools.description: Delete elements and their Revit dependencies when removal is intended; IDs are unitless and the returned count includes dependents.

tools.name: revit_reset_element_ids
tools.description: Replace elements with copies so Revit assigns new element IDs; the API cannot assign one itself.

tools.name: revit_rebuild_model_ids
tools.description: Give every component new IDs by copying a 3D view's selectable elements into a new model, because Revit does not allow assigning an element ID.

tools.name: revit_batch
tools.description: Execute up to 50 actions with one undo step; roll back the batch on its first failure.

REVIT_MCP_HOST.title: Workstation host
REVIT_MCP_HOST.description: Use local on the Windows Revit workstation, ssh:<alias> for a configured SSH host, or http://host:port (https://host:port with a TLS proxy) for HTTP. macOS and Linux require a remote Windows workstation. Prefer a loopback tunnel for HTTP.

REVIT_MCP_REDACT_PATHS.title: Redact model paths
REVIT_MCP_REDACT_PATHS.description: Hide directories in response path fields. Model names, parameter values, errors and exported image localPath values remain visible.

REVIT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE.title: Allow actions (dangerous)
REVIT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE.description: Dangerous: enables actions that can change the Revit model. Also requires the workstation allow-write file. Leave disabled for read-only use.

REVIT_MCP_TOKEN.title: HTTP bearer token
REVIT_MCP_TOKEN.description: Required only for HTTP or HTTPS. Use the token from the workstation settings.json. Leave empty for local or SSH.
